outputs.successNote:
Below 98 runecrafting, each pure essence consumes up to 2 extracts, producing runes based on the number of extracts used: 2 extracts → 122 runes, 1 extract → 62 runes.
At 98–99 runecrafting, each pure essence consumes up to 3 extracts, producing runes based on the number of extracts used: 3 extracts → 183 runes, 2 extracts → 123 runes, 1 extract → 63 runes.
[[Raiments of the Eye]] will not multiply the additional runes from the extract.
